retrievalProfile.description: A studio portrait featuring a close-up subject with moody purple-blue lighting, framed by a thick double-line border and high-contrast neon yellow condensed typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, slightly angled studio portrait of a male subject wearing a textured jacket, set against a soft purple gradient background. The composition is enclosed in a black and yellow double border, with vibrant yellow condensed italic serif text in the upper left and white sans-serif text in the lower left.
coreVisualRelationships: The neon yellow text creates a sharp color contrast against the deep purple background tones.
The subject's downward gaze directs the viewer's eye toward the bottom-left typography.
The thick black border with a thin yellow inner line provides a structural frame that contains the soft studio lighting.
coreInvariants: Moody, directional studio lighting with blue/purple shadows

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the right two-thirds of the frame, cropped at the chest and shoulders.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face, specifically the highlighted forehead and cheek, serves as the primary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the large yellow text top-left, moves across the subject's face, and ends at the white text bottom-left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper left quadrant is reserved for primary typography against a soft gradient.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep purple and indigo (background and shadows)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Neon yellow (primary text and inner border)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the accent colors against a low-value, moody background.

letterConstructionRules: Primary text uses an extreme vertical compression
High stroke contrast with sharp, pointed serifs
Secondary text is a clean, heavy-weight sans-serif
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'L' has a short, sharp foot
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast serif for the name paired with a neutral, heavy sans-serif for the title.
graphicDevices: Soft diagonal light beams in background

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high-contrast, ultra-condensed serif look.
Provides the necessary stroke contrast and sharp serifs.
Suitable for the secondary sans-serif text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of a man in a textured dark leather jacket against a purple and indigo gradient background with soft diagonal light streaks. Frame the image with a thick black border containing a thin yellow inner line. Leave the top-left and bottom-left areas clear for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, ultra-condensed italic serif text in neon yellow in the top-left corner. Add bold italic sans-serif text in white in the bottom-left corner.

verificationChecks: Is the primary text neon yellow?
Is the border a double-line black and yellow frame?
Is the background a purple/indigo gradient?
Is the main font ultra-condensed and italic?

adjustableVariables: Background color hue (e.g., blue vs purple)
Intensity of the neon yellow text
mustRedesign: Do not use the specific artist name or album title
Do not replicate the exact facial features of the subject

mustAchieve: Moody studio lighting with colored shadows

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the yellow border is thin and perfectly aligned inside the black border.
Check that the condensed text remains legible despite its narrow width.
Verify the purple lighting wash covers the background and subject shadows.
Confirm the subject's gaze is directed downward or away from the camera.
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio Portrait + Purple Gradient + Ultra-Condensed Yellow Serif + Double Border Frame
